summary: End-to-end testing of the password reset flow (forgot-password + reset-password). All 7 backend pytest cases and all 4 frontend flows passed. Backend: forgot-password with existing email creates a password_reset_tokens doc (used=false, expires_at ~1h in future) and returns {ok:true}; non-existent email returns {ok:true} with NO token doc (no user enumeration leak); invalid token → 400 'Token inválido ou já usado'; short password → 400 'Senha muito curta'; full happy path (signup → forgot → reset → login old pw fails (401) → login new pw succeeds (200) → token flagged used=true with used_at → prior user_sessions deleted); reusing a used token → 400 'Este link já foi utilizado. Solicite outro.'; expired token (manually patched expires_at) → 400 'Este link expirou. Solicite outro.'. Frontend: Login page /entrar shows [data-testid='forgot-link'] → /esqueci-senha; /esqueci-senha renders [data-testid='forgot-page'], submit shows [data-testid='forgot-sent'] with 'Verifique seu e-mail'; /redefinir-senha?token=<t> renders [data-testid='reset-page']; mismatched passwords → toast 'Senhas não coincidem'; <6 chars → toast 'Mínimo 6 caracteres'; valid submit → [data-testid='reset-done'] 'Senha redefinida!' + auto-redirect to /entrar after ~2.5s. Post-flow verification: new password logs in (200); old password rejected (401).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot_password: reset link falls back to hardcoded 'https://arenahub.app/redefinir-senha?token=...' when both origin_url and APP_URL are empty. In production this could be problematic — consider raising or logging a warning instead of silently using a placeholder domain.

reset_password swallows expired-token vs invalid-token distinction correctly, but there is no rate-limit on /auth/forgot-password. An attacker can enumerate emails indirectly by timing/DB load, and can also spam the mail provider. Add IP+email rate limiting.
Token is stored in plaintext in Mongo. If DB is leaked, all pending reset tokens are usable. Consider storing sha256(token) and comparing hashes.

ResetPassword.jsx: on backend error (used/expired/invalid token) the toast shows but the form is still enabled; user gets no clear 'request a new link' CTA on this page. Consider surfacing a persistent error banner with a link to /esqueci-senha.

ForgotPassword.jsx: after Enter is pressed with an already-set email, there is no client-side cooldown — repeated clicks will create multiple tokens (each superseding the previous only implicitly). Add a per-email 60s cooldown UI hint.
Password strength is only min-length 6 on both client and server. Consider adding common-password/complexity checks.
